projects.title: Athena
projects.description:
Won "Best Use of Google Cloud" Award at the RUHackathon

Our project uses Google Cloud Speech and Storage to take educational videos and turn them into 5 sentence blurbs summarizing the video based on keywords given to the program through user input.
This program can be used by students everywhere to take long lecture videos on topics they may come across in class and become conversationally proficient in them.

projects.title: Savinn' (LaunchX-STEM)
projects.description: A startup design created through the club LaunchX-STEM, which was created by MIT. Our startup worked on recycling plastic and utilizing new technology to turn it into marketable items, primarily clothing. After presenting our presentation plan to a panel of entrepreneurs, our team earned the reward of "Best Presentation."
